sources_considered.why: OpenAI's own announcement that the recapitalization was complete. The live site refuses automated reads, so the Internet Archive copy from October 29, 2025 was used.

evidence_items.locator: opening paragraph, post dated October 28, 2025, by Bret Taylor

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has completed its recapitalization, simplifying its corporate structure. The nonprofit remains in control of the for-profit

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI said on October 28, 2025 that it had completed its recapitalization of the for-profit. That is before the end of 2025, so the antecedent (no conversion by the end of the year) did not happen. This is the company's own statement about itself.
